pages.text: Ruin guards, transports, and commanders leave cores restored with seals. $(l:world/mine_recovery)Mine cores$() come from broken corpses or mine remnants and use command fragments instead. Restoration makes a new companion; your own fallen companions use their usual revival.

Hold a core and right-click a $(item)Slime Restoration Station$(). Keep one slimeball and one catalyst in your inventory: a seal for ruin cores, or an Old Command Fragment for mine cores. Mine cores require the Overworld. Materials are consumed once and the core becomes a summon item. Find an intact station in ruins or craft one with the recipe shown here.

Guards become $(l:companions/royal_guard)Royal Guards$(), carriers become $(l:companions/transport)Transports$(), and commanders become $(l:companions/commander)Commanders$(). Each receives a new identity and your ownership, and starts waiting at one health. The usual group-wide Commander spawn limit still applies.

Ancient names and white insignia remain. Useful stats receive 12–28 invested upgrades, including old Endurance training. Each core keeps its roll through saving and recovery and can be restored once. Crafting a Combat Slime with a seal instead retains that companion’s exact growth.
Craft at a workbench; cracked stations cannot restore cores. JEI’s Slime Restoration category shows all six recipes.
